description: Figure 4.1 (first of the five plots) illustrates word error rate (WER) over fine-tuning epochs for the Whisper model with “type = base,” showing multiple training configurations as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 20 to 60 with labeled ticks at 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. Five blue lines with circular markers are shown: a solid line labeled “base AdaLoRA_init4” decreases from about 60 at epoch 0 to about 38 at epoch 6, with intermediate values around 49 (epoch 2) and 40 (epoch 5); a dashed line labeled “base AdaLoRA_init8” drops from about 58 at epoch 0 to about 36 at epoch 6, passing near 38 at epoch 2 and about 35–36 around epochs 3–5; a dotted line labeled “base init4” declines from about 59 at epoch 0 to about 33 at epoch 6, reaching about 37 at epoch 2 and staying near 35–36 around epochs 3–5; a dash-dot line labeled “base init8” decreases from about 57 at epoch 0 to about 37 at epoch 6, with values near 45 at epoch 2 and about 39–40 around epochs 4–5; and a low solid line labeled “base full” remains near 21 at epoch 0 and gradually decreases to about 19 by epoch 6, with small stepwise changes around 20–21 through epochs 1–4.
